en: Black‑and‑white photographic view of a large brick Gothic church with a massive square tower on the left, steep tiled roofs, tall pointed windows with tracery, and buttresses. The building stands by an open square with a few small trees and several people posing in front, suggesting an early 20th‑century postcard or photographic print. The image has a dark border and slight corner damage typical of old postcards or glass‑plate reproductions. No printed caption or writing is visible on the front.
